quotes.text: Ok let's get the next thing started
We have accepted change sets as well
Let's pick the next crucial change sets to run so you can orchestrate them autonomously overnight.

fields.summary: With milestone 5 landed, the owner asked to get the next thing started, pointed out that accepted change sets exist (all of them turn out to be the twelve 'Area' umbrella change sets, which have no leaves), and asked to pick the next crucial change sets for the orchestrator to run autonomously overnight. The orchestrator ranked candidates by what needed its hand during milestones 4 and 5: review and arbiter sessions opening a window each (Rex's 64-window limit), links whose endpoint kinds rhiza check refuses only after land, plan runs leaving their plan uncommitted for a hand-made PR, and runs stalling or failing when their PR branch was updated by someone else. The owner picked all four, and the three smaller ones too: plan runs with open findings stopping for the owner, failed review fixers retried within their cycle, and housekeeping (removing the all-apps picker and fixing the read-apps-match-cli capability text).
fields.title: Milestone 6: Rhiza runs unattended overnight
